unit: One contract quantity unit represents 1000 PEPE; prices are USDT per 1000PEPE, not per PEPE.
selection: 1000 logical PPO agents, synchronous population generations, 1024 PPO training decisions per agent per generation. Same rotating two-day development probe for every agent in a generation. Only age>=5 can be replaced; preserve top10%, replace bottom20% (including5% fresh immigrants). Inherit whole compatible weights and mutate learning_rate, ent_coef, gamma, clip_range. Every50generations evaluate current leaders on full fixed development quarter and archive the anchor winner. After generation1000 evaluate up to10 development finalists on validation; freeze winner/modelSHA before a single final-test evaluation. Never select by final test.
notes: Population-based PPO adapted from PBT;250 is an experiment setting, not a universal minimum. Three workers in boost, one in eco; never250 simultaneous training processes.

Fresh PEPE PPO, no ETH/G151 weights. Installed FinRL0.3.7 DRLAgent supplies PPO; custom Gymnasium futures environment. New registration after an initial attempt failed on zero-volume-derived-feature gaps; initial attempt and data/source snapshots preserved under work/pepe-finrl-v1.

Five-minute decisions only use closed bars. Zero-volume bars remain explicit observations; no invented fills in minutes with no trades. Hard risk exits wait for the first tradable open if needed; funding and mark valuation continue.

Training: June2023–September2024, excluding August2024 from financial episodes. Rotating development: October–December2024. Validation January–June2025 is not used for population mutations. Final test July2025–August2026 is locked until selection. September2026 remains reserved.

Training episodes independently reset seven-day contiguous training windows. Development probes independently reset two-day windows; these are selection samples, not a compounded investment curve. Anchor development, validation and final test are continuous wallets.

Agent selects leverage10x or15x only on entry. Position sizing still risks1% including modeled costs; leverage is not an automatic1.5x profit multiplier. No pyramiding or immediate reversal while a position is open.
Best/worst trades are ranked by position-level net after all modeled costs and funding, aggregating partial fills. Development examples and final-test examples stay distinctly labeled.

No fixed profit target or holding deadline for PPO. Initial ATR stop, liquidation, daily/global loss limits and observation boundary remain mandatory. Duration is measured; not all learned positions necessarily qualify as scalps.
Reward=100*(change in marked equity/initial equity - 0.25*increase in current drawdown). Includes entry/exit costs and unrealized losses; inactivity not artificially penalized.

PEPE selection is a user hypothesis. Volatility alone is not evidence of profitability. Historical book/spread unavailable; assumed slippage is fixed in advance and stressed, never labeled measured spread.

Filters are the current observed exchange specifications applied retrospectively; maintenance/liquidation are approximations, not historical account brackets. Funding uses archived timestamps. Before taxes, fixed FX5BRL/USDT.

Known historical asset selected after prior ETH research. Temporal separation limits leakage but this is retrospective research, not independent proof of future profit. No final-test feedback into training.
BTC/news features are not supplied in this first PEPE experiment; unavailable history is not fabricated. No network market calls during learning. No paid AI APIs or account credentials.
Shared chart period July2025–August2026 aligns with existing G151 causal scores. September2026 PEPE is downloaded but reserved and never evaluated in this experiment.

Isolated1000-agent fork: parent250 run remains immutable. Same initial seeds for paired first250 members, market features, actions, risk and dates. Equal-step exploratory POC compares250G200 with1000G50, and250G1000 with1000G250. Fixed-quarter development audits only; one run per population does not establish statistical superiority. New run starts from fresh weights, not selected parent weights.
